title: Contact Manager with Validation
summary: Desktop contact management application with input validation and file-backed persistence.

steps.description: Perform email address structure and non-empty name assertions
Save validated contact cards into JSON storage

explanations.beginner: This application stores your contact list with names, emails, and phone numbers. It checks that every email address looks valid before saving it to your computer.
explanations.intermediate: The recipe defines a custom `Contact` type and combines `otter-official/text-utils` with structural string scanning to validate email format `@` and `.`. Valid entries are appended to a persistent list.
explanations.advanced: Separates validation business logic from UI and storage. On Windows, the contact cards bind to the desktop WebView2 bridge. On macOS/Linux and headless CI, the validation and contact storage execute natively via standard IO.
